law.name: selector-suffix-extension
law.statement: For each proved D9 selector p/name, D10 p0 appends A before R and D10 p1 appends D before R.
law.authority_boundary: The selector law crosses from D9 because it is independently proved and anchored in the ratified D8 selector lineage; no other unratified D9 placement is inherited.
